topic: Licence route for commercial access to Vietnamese genetic resources, including microbes
claim_a: Decree 59/2017 as written, summarised in ch07 section 7.10 and app-s9-regulation S9.16 (REG-60): registration in 10 days, commune certification of the contract, council review up to 90 days, decision within 15 days, ministry licence
claim_b: Decree 43/2026, Chapter III (SLF-02): provincial People's Committee chairman issues the licence; council formed in 3 working days, reports in 10, decision about 19 working days from a complete file; registration step and commune certification gone; standard contract Form 12; licence up to 5 years
position_taken: Decree 43/2026 governs from 26 January 2026; benefit-sharing rates in Art 22 of Decree 59/2017 are unchanged
notes: A correction rather than a conflict between sources; the package text predates our reading of the amendment

topic: Ethanol-plant retrofit precedent for microbial protein
claim_a: GFI-089 (GSD-01, modified 2022): Superbrewed Food retrofits bioethanol facilities for protein production
claim_b: AgFunder News (SLF-12, February 2024): the Minnesota ethanol-plant retrofit was paused and first volumes moved to Dohler in Europe; Protein Production Technology (SLF-14, April 2024): the Little Falls, Minnesota site was sold
position_taken: The later, specific press reports: the retrofit did not proceed as GFI describes
notes: GFI's database text is out of date; GFI claims are advocacy and were checked against press
